description: query-responses.md gives the Common Metrics object and the Analytics-only Metrics object the exact same one-line description verbatim - 'An object containing metrics about the request.' - with nothing on the page distinguishing why a query response carries two separately-named metrics objects (one with six fields: elapsedTime/executionTime/resultCount/resultSize/errorCount/warningCount; one with a single field, processedObjects) rather than one merged object. A reader has to infer the split from the schema tables alone.
